name: Fleshwarp Fetters
disable: DC 30 Arcana check (trained) or DC 30 Occultism check (expert) to disrupt the magic, or Dispel Magic (6th rank, DC 28) to counteract the fleshwarping

items.name: Hobble
items.text:
Trigger A creature enters the area marked T on the map

---
Effect Each creature in the marked area must attempt a DC 32 Fortitude save save.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune to the effects of warpline hazards for 1 hour.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature's limbs twist unnaturally. They take a –5-foot status penalty to their Speeds for 1 day.

Critical Failure The creature takes a –10-foot status penalty to their Speeds for 1 week.

text: A surge of fleshwarping magic twists creatures' limbs, especially those used to move.
